title: Authorize system role management with live menu authority, bounded field validation and guarded role-menu assignment
description: Stage 3 access-control closure for the role records and role-to-menu bindings that the existing menu authorisation of every operational route reads. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/RoleController.cs:17 declares RoleController with only [ApiController]/[Route(`api/sys/roles`)]/[Authorize] and no identity, account-state or menu resolution; GetPaged 27-41 and GetAll 44-49 read all roles, GetRoleMenus 52-58 returns assigned menu ids, GetById 61-67 returns a role, Create 70-88 only checks the duplicate role code at 73-74, Update 91-103 rewrites name/description, Delete 106-118 soft-deletes, and the private SaveRoleMenusAsync 120-127 at 122-126 removes every existing SysRoleMenu and inserts one link per supplied menuId with no menu validation, so any authenticated account can create a role, attach an arbitrary menu (including system menus) to it and thereby widen the menu authority that the other controllers now enforce. Reuse the existing role-management functional menu (src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:16) on every route, add bounded server-side validation for the persisted SysRole columns (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/SysRoleMenu.cs:10-26) and validate that every supplied menu id resolves to a known nondeleted menu before any SysRoleMenus link is written, and keep the existing unique role-code index (src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/ErpDbContext.Config.cs:21), the IsSystem delete protection and the all-or-nothing role-menu replacement semantics unchanged. No Domain/Infrastructure/schema change, no grants, no anonymous/admin fallback. Genuine isolated (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST SQL only; safe Release build plus full ERP.UnitTests.
acceptance_criteria: For every route on /api/sys/roles (paged, all, by-id, role-menus, create, update and delete) require the current enabled nondeleted identity and the existing role-management functional menu before any read or write, rejecting missing, disabled, deleted and revoked-menu identities with the existing controlled non-disclosing errors and adding no new grants or anonymous/admin fallback.

Validate on create and update that RoleName and RoleCode are non-empty and within their persisted length bounds, that Description stays within its persisted bound and that every assigned menu id resolves to a known nondeleted menu, so an invalid or forged menu id never persists a SysRoleMenus link, keeping the existing unique role-code index, IsSystem delete protection and all-or-nothing role-menu replacement semantics unchanged and persisting no SysRoles or SysRoleMenus row on denial.

Genuine isolated SQL authenticated controller tests cover the permitted privileged and menu-granted flows, missing role menu, disabled, deleted and revoked identities and invalid role-name, code, description and menu-id payloads, and assert that denied paged, all, by-id, role-menus, create, update and delete calls read or mutate no SysRoles or SysRoleMenus row while the existing RoleControllerTests and AuthServiceTests contracts stay green.

Keep the safe Release build and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, use only genuine isolated (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST databases with Integrated Security, and add no schema, entity, menu, permission or production/secret change; build completion is not stage acceptance.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/RoleController.cs:14-17 declares RoleController with only [ApiController]/[Route(api/sys/roles)]/[Authorize] and no Authoriz/Menu/identity-resolution reference: GetPaged 27-41, GetAll 44-49, GetRoleMenus 52-58, GetById 61-67, Create 70-88 (only the duplicate-code check at 73-74), Update 91-103 and Delete 106-118 query and write _db.SysRoles/SysRoleMenus directly, and the private SaveRoleMenusAsync 120-127 at 122-126 removes all existing SysRoleMenus rows then inserts a link for every supplied menuId with no menu-id validation. SysRole (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/SysRoleMenu.cs:10-26) persists RoleName(50)/RoleCode(50)/Description(200)/IsSystem and SysRoleMenu (78-85) persists RoleId/MenuId with only attribute annotations; the unique index is src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/ErpDbContext.Config.cs:21 and the existing role-management menu is seeded at src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:16. Role-menu bindings are the authority consulted by every operational menu check (src/ERP.Application/Services/AuthService.Helpers.cs:15-51 BuildCurrentUserAsync/BuildMenuTreeAsync) and existing regression contracts are src/ERP.UnitTests/RoleControllerTests.cs and src/ERP.UnitTests/AuthServiceTests.cs. There is no RoleAuthorizationRules in src/ERP.Application/Services and an exact search of .ai/tasks returns no task listing RoleController for live authorization.
